verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM lets users chat with their own documents via RAG, run custom agent workflows/skills, and auto-generate meeting summaries with action items, key decisions, and transcripts — all clear forms of AI-generated insight from user data (anythingllm-docs-2, -3, -10, -17, -22). Community hands-on use corroborates the RAG chat functionality, though one user noted citation snippets were sometimes garbled (anythingllm-comm-1, anythingllm-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of insight/summary accuracy beyond one anecdotal report, and more detail on agent-flow output quality.
